questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of branding for a teen’s side hustle?

options.text: To make products more expensive
To create recognition and trust among customers
To copy big companies like Nike or Coca-Cola
To confuse customers with complicated designs

correct_answer.text: To create recognition and trust among customers

questions.question_text: When choosing a brand name for your hustle, what is an important factor to consider?

options.text: Making it as long and detailed as possible
Ensuring it is short, catchy, and easy to remember
Using a name that no one can pronounce
Copying a popular brand’s name to gain attention

correct_answer.text: Ensuring it is short, catchy, and easy to remember

questions.question_text: Which free tool is recommended in the chapter for teens to create a simple logo for their hustle?

options.text: Adobe Photoshop
Microsoft Word
Canva
Paintbrush

questions.question_text: How can incorporating cultural elements into branding help a teen’s side hustle?

options.text: It makes the brand look outdated and boring
It creates an emotional connection with the local audience
It confuses customers about the product
It only works for international markets

correct_answer.text: It creates an emotional connection with the local audience

questions.question_text: What is a key aspect of building a personal brand as a teen entrepreneur?

options.text: Pretending to be someone you’re not to impress others
Being authentic and consistent in how you present yourself online and offline
Avoiding social media to keep your hustle private
Only focusing on your product and ignoring your reputation

correct_answer.text: Being authentic and consistent in how you present yourself online and offline
